name: Etou Mizushi
source: He is a university student at Renkaku University. He has happily repeated a year and is retrying his fourth year. Despite his frivolous appearance, he is actually the heir to an old and distinguished family.
translation: He is a university student at Renkaku University. He has happily repeated a year and is retrying his fourth year. Despite his frivolous appearance, he is actually the heir to an old and distinguished family.
